newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Hun Sen says he will welcome ASEAN envoys.
newsitem.headline: Hun Sen says he will welcome ASEAN envoys.

text.p: Cambodian Second Prime Minister Hun Sen said on Monday he would welcome envoys from ASEAN back to Phnom Penh but did not specify what their role might be in in mediating a resolution to the Cambodia crisis.
"Now we are ready to welcome a new special envoy of ASEAN soon," Hun Sen said when asked to clarify his position on any intervention by the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN).
Hun Sen did not elaborate on what role ASEAN envoys might play, but in a statement last week he said ASEAN had a role in preventing foreign interference.

ASEAN sent three foreign ministers to Phnom Penh earlier this month to try to help resolve political turmoil in the aftermath of Hun Sen's ouster of First Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh, but Hun Sen flatly rejected any mediation efforts.
Foreign Minister Ung Huot later said ASEAN could play a mediation role, throwing the regional grouping into confusion about what Hun Sen actually wanted.
ASEAN has asked Ung Huot to clarify Cambodia's position.
